GF_WORK_COVER.title: Workers’ Comp
GF_WORK_COVER.description: Lose 1 HP. Insure an ally until {IfUpgraded:show:combat ends|next turn}. The next time an enemy attack costs them HP and they survive, heal them for 5 and draw 1 extra next turn. One payout per ally per combat.
GF_OFFER_BOTTLE.title: After You
GF_OFFER_BOTTLE.description: You and an ally secretly choose Take or Pass. One taker gains 2 Energy. If both pass, each gains 1 Energy next turn. If both take, deal 2 damage to each of you and 8 to ALL enemies.
GF_ASSIST.title: Just an Assist
GF_ASSIST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If an ally kills the target this turn, gain 8 Gold and give the killer 2 Gold. One bounty per team per combat.
GF_HOT_POT.title: Hot Potato
GF_HOT_POT.description: Hold the pot. After playing a card, its holder may pass it to an ally. At turn end deal 5 to its holder and 4 to ALL enemies. Each pass adds {IfUpgraded:show:1|2} and {IfUpgraded:show:3|4} damage respectively.
GF_DONT_GREED.title: One Last Hit
GF_DONT_GREED.description: Give an ally {Block:diff()} Block and add 2 [gold]Just One{IfUpgraded:show:+}[/gold] to their hand.
GF_TRUST_ME.title: Trust Me, One HP
GF_TRUST_ME.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. After the next allied Attack hits this enemy this turn, deal {IfUpgraded:show:12|9} more. If it survives, lose 3 HP through Block.
GF_BORROW.title: I'll Pay You Back
GF_BORROW.description: Ask an ally to spend 1 Energy. If they agree, gain 2 Energy and repay 1 next turn. {IfUpgraded:show:The lender draws 1. }If they decline, gain 4 Block.
GF_LIGHTS_OUT.title: Last One Out
GF_LIGHTS_OUT.description: At turn end, if exactly one player saved Energy, all gain {IfUpgraded:show:10|8} Block. If several did, only they gain 4 Block. If nobody did, gain 1 Vulnerable.
GF_SAME_HERE.title: Same Here
GF_SAME_HERE.description: Choose an ally. Starting next turn, if your first card after their opening card matches its type, both gain {IfUpgraded:show:6|5} Block. Once per turn.
GF_SPLIT_REWARDS.title: You Split, I Pick
GF_SPLIT_REWARDS.description: Randomly split 2 Energy, draw 2, and 6 Block into a single and a pair. An ally chooses a bundle. Take the other. Whoever took the pair draws 1 less next turn.
GF_QUIZ.title: I Know This One
GF_QUIZ.description: Guess Attack, Skill or Power, then an ally draws 1. On a match, that card costs 2 less this turn. {IfUpgraded:show:They draw 1 more. }On a miss or no draw, put a Dazed on top of your draw pile.
GF_KEYBOARD.title: Here, You Play
GF_KEYBOARD.description: Discard an Attack. Give an ally an Ethereal, Exhausting copy that is free this turn. {IfUpgraded:show:Draw 1 the first time they play it. }If still in their hand at turn end, gain 4 Block.
GF_INSURANCE.title: Accidental Death
GF_INSURANCE.description: Give a player [gold]Death Insurance[/gold] for {IfUpgraded:show:2 turns|1 turn}. Renewals add duration. On death, revive next turn at 1 HP, clear buffs and gain 1 extra Energy. Pending claims advance a party wipe to the next turn.
GF_FOCUS_FIRE.title: Focus Fire, Right?
GF_FOCUS_FIRE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies, or {IfUpgraded:show:13|10} to each enemy an ally's Attack already hit this turn.
GF_SAVE_SHIELD.title: Leave Me the Shield
GF_SAVE_SHIELD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this breaks the target's Block, the next ally to hit it with an Attack this turn gains 1 Energy.
GF_SAVE_POTION.title: Saving That Potion?
GF_SAVE_POTION.description: Give an ally {Block:diff()} Block. The next time they use a potion this turn, you each draw 1.
GF_BIG_SPENDER.title: Big Spender
GF_BIG_SPENDER.description: Each turn, the first time an ally spends at least 2 Energy playing one card, draw 1. {IfUpgraded:show:That ally gains 4 Block.}
GF_SCRAP.title: Scrap Collector
GF_SCRAP.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Statuses currently in all players' hands gain Ethereal this turn. At turn end gain 3 Block for each of those cards exhausted by Ethereal.
GF_LOG_OFF.title: Logging Off
GF_LOG_OFF.description: An ally gains X+1 Energy and draws {IfUpgraded:show:2 cards|1 card}. End your own turn.
GF_CROWD.title: Quite a Crowd
GF_CROWD.description: At combat start, automatically play this. Transform it into a random {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded }multiplayer card with Retain and add it to your hand.
GF_ONE_TAP.title: Just One
GF_CHOICE.title: Choice
